fields.label: Refresh interval
fields.description: Minutes between update-count checks (checkupdates / paru -Qua / flatpak remote-ls --updates).

fields.label: External monitors only
fields.description: Hide the updates button on internal laptop panels (screen names starting with eDP).

fields.label: Show in bar when up to date
fields.description: Keep the bar button visible with a green check when there are no pending updates.

fields.label: Scan pacman
fields.description: Include pacman repo packages in the automatic update counts.

fields.label: Scan AUR
fields.description: Include AUR updates (via the detected helper) in the automatic update counts.

fields.label: Scan flatpak
fields.description: Include flatpak updates in the automatic update counts.
